glitches.title: Jump Kick (JK)
glitches.search_desc: Roll into a corner to get higher, a classic
glitches.how_to: From the air (usually after a jump), do a kick into a geometry corner with the proper angle to maximize the upward boost.
glitches.note: This specific clip is from the older demo. It still remains possible but has been nerfed since then. Conditioned to a higher framerate (ideally, 120fps no vsync).

glitches.title: Jump Switch (JS)
glitches.search_desc: Small boost upwards allowing bigger jumps
glitches.how_to: As water form, jump and quickly switch into One.

variations.text: Poison Jump Switch - When releasing the poison jump, delay your switch ~0.3s to receive a big momentum up as One.

glitches.note: Mostly used in speedrun as the poison variation, but the basic water Jump Switch still gains a small boost and allows to chain very fast jumps (see the Form Dash notes).

glitches.title: Wave Dash (WD)
glitches.search_desc: Big horizontal boost often used for parkour
glitches.alt_names: Hyper Dash (like in Celeste), Long Jump, Collision Jump...
glitches.how_to: From the air (usually after a jump), dash into a walkable surface and quickly press jump. Possible on flat and inclined surfaces: delay between dash and jump may depend on the geometry.

variations.text: Wave Dash + Switch - Combination of Wave Dash and Jump Switch. As water form and in the air dash > jump > switch into One. Allows to get a bit more height/distance, like here.
Poison Wave Dash - As water form, Wave Dash into poison to get a boost up.
Poison Wave Dash + Switch - Even bigger: combined to the Poison Jump Switch by delaying the switch ~0.3s.

glitches.note: Often used in the run, especially in the intro before getting the Form Dash. Seems conditioned to a higher framerate (ideally, 120fps no vsync).

glitches.title: Form Dash (FD)
glitches.search_desc: Central move for many mobility techniques - FDJ, FDP, New Form Dash

variations.text: Ground version - Faster way to move on the ground by optimally chaining the inputs. Perfect for Jojo / Infinite Dash.
Air version - Discovered first, it's an essential way to extend the jump ability. To properly chain it, start as water form > Jump Switch > Form Dash > land and quickly repeat cycle.
Form Dash Jump (FDJ) - To raise from the ground and cover great horizontal distance (similarly to the Wave Dash): Dash > switch > jump.
Form Dash Pinguin (FDP) - Press jump > switch > dash within ~0.3s. This will perform a Form Dash without switching to One, staying as water form and allowing to keep a stored item.

New Form Dash ❗ - An update introduced a precise timing allowing to keep the water form, the execution of the dash seemingly cancelling the switch into One. It deeply combines with the existing variations, allowing many optimized moves and to efficiently carry power cores.

glitches.note: Central move for many mobility techniques, constantly used after the intro.

glitches.title: Glitch² (GG)
glitches.search_desc: Become insensible to enemy attacks and other liquids
glitches.how_to: As One gets affected by the glitch, dash away from the edge of the pool to fall/void during the animation. Canceled by going back to the main menu.
glitches.note: This is a hidden liquid/color still accessible in the demo, giving us a glimpse on the future puzzles and exploits we might be able to do in the full game... No real use found yet but great potential for the full game and its most intense combat phases.

glitches.title: Portal Glitch
glitches.search_desc: Exit a working portal - OOB, Pyramid Rob, Portal Void Cancel
glitches.alt_names: Portal Wrong Load, Portal Escape Glitch
glitches.how_to: As glitch form, place a teleportation mark out of a portal, stand on the central button and quickly teleport back. The camera will turn to aim the mark you left, leaving enough time for the portal to fully activate before you get teleported. Once escaped, the level will unload and switch to the targeted one, leaving you free for a few seconds.

variations.text: Out-of-Bounds - Can be used to unload walls and go OOB. Opening the start menu at a specific moment can allow the new level to load while suspending your position.
Pyramid Rob - Taking advantage of the levels swapping, get into a pyramid box to steal its power core and escape using the glitch teleportation.
Portal Void Cancel - Use the portal loading time to fall without being respawned and cover great distances downwards.

glitches.note: Exit a working portal using the glitch teleportation, to perform a variety of skips and exploits.

glitches.title: Respawn Item Portal (RIP)
glitches.search_desc: Bypass the standard portal travel by teleporting an item alone
glitches.how_to: Leave an item in the bubble showing the pre-rendered other level and quickly restart from last checkpoint or void to respawn there (loading screen), leaving some time on the other side to grab the item.

glitches.title: Respawn Aim Shot (RAS)
glitches.search_desc: Force an enemy to aim at you while respawning elsewhere
glitches.how_to: Simply restart from last checkpoint (in the same level / no loading screen) just before the shot visualization appears. Theoretically possible using a soft/void checkpoint, but the window is small.
glitches.note: Forces an enemy to aim at you while you quickly respawn elsewhere, allowing to get certain elements to inappropriate locations.

glitches.title: Cutscene Skip (CS)
glitches.search_desc: Key glitch for Any% runs - WR 3:57.04
glitches.how_to: From the main menu, choose new game > difficulty and when you validate, quickly press down and enter. What it does is that for a brief moment after starting, you're still able to navigate through the menu: going down and validating makes you choose CONTINUE. Right after that, hold your direction forward, dash, jump and attack. You should be able to hear these actions during the black-screen (and feel a vibration after the attack).
glitches.extra_content:
To summarize:

Enter > Down > Enter > Hold stick forward > Dash > Jump > Attack

Associated room: #Cutscene Skip on the Discord.
glitches.note: It's at the base of many important glitches like the next ones (Void Cancel, Infinite Dash, etc.). It is a key glitch that allowed us along with an incredible teamwork to get a WR (3:57.04) runned by @Hulien. The timings are not so quick and very precise, it is recommended trying different timings and picking the one that suits your playstyle or watch (and listen to) this. You know you did it right if One doesn't talk right after the cutscene and there is no camera movement. It is highly recommended to have the sound of the game turned on, so you can hear your inputs.

glitches.title: Void Cancel (VC/DC)
glitches.search_desc: Fall forever, bypass void, respawn and death
glitches.how_to: After the Cutscene Skip, fall until the game tries to respawn you - it will fail and you'll instead continuously receive void damages. Go back to menu and continue. You will now be able to fall forever, no void, no respawn but also no death (life bar can't be reduced to 0HP).

variations.text: No Cutscene Skip ❌ - this version is done by interrupting One's death animation. Lose almost all HP (faster in Hard difficulty) > Fall to your death > Pause buffer to aim the first frames of the death animation (you take the last hit just after respawning). You may struggle a bit to force the start menu when the animation initiates. Sometimes the controller is vibrating on this frame and continuously goes on when you're in the pause menu - but it's not mandatory, just a good sign > Go back to main menu and continue > You should be back unkillable and with the ability to fall forever.

glitches.note: This glitch allows you to bypass both death and the fall limit that respawns you on the ground. You will be able to stay alive forever, and to cover great vertical and horizontal distances in the air. This state resists everything, even rebooting the game. It seems stuck to the save file and you'll have to continue without ever dying or voiding again... Just be careful not to fall for too long or you'll get a "fatal error" crash (the glitch still remaining active after restarting).
glitches.button_text: Read the Complete Void Cancel Guide

glitches.title: Infinite Dash (ID)
glitches.how_to: Through the Cutscene Skip method, restart from checkpoint (it should not replace you anywhere, the CS doesn't register the first hard checkpoint) and start mashing dashes.

variations.text: Void Infinite Dash (CS / no VC) - You will get stuck in the air continuously losing HP but able to "fly" towards your destination (restarting checkpoint allows you to refill your HP and potions).
Voidless Infinite Dash (CS / VC) ❌ - You will be able to naturally infinite dash without losing HP.

Respawn Infinite Dash (No CS) - Can work without specific setup: just mash the dash after respawning from a fall/void; ideally from a spot that gets you in the air like shown in the clip. This can't last very long and the game will quickly make you respawn if you don't go above surfaces to reset the void timer.

glitches.title: Jojo ❌
glitches.search_desc: Fly and never fall - allows the Volcano Skip
glitches.how_to: Fall and void next to a pipe to respawn back to the soft checkpoint in a previous level. You'll be standing onto an invisible floor, unable to jump, with the possibility to work your hitbox up or down by entering in contact with the environment - find the ideal collisions in the level design to navigate. The fastest way to move horizontally is the Form Dash and vertically by facing an inclined wall as One without dashing. It allows the Volcano Skip. Canceled by entering a pipe, watching a cutscene that repositions One or going back to the main menu.
glitches.note: ❌ Not possible anymore, until further proof. Allows to fly and prevents to fall by locking One into a walking state.

glitches.title: Infinite Core (IC)
glitches.search_desc: Conserve an element core to keep using it without limitation - ICW, ICP, ICS, ICG
glitches.how_to: Work in progress - Much efforts have been made to figure out a consistent setup but help is still needed. For now, the best way to do it is by grabbing any element core and repeatedly fall/void with it. You should respawn with the UI showing the core, even as One. Canceled by grabbing another core or going back to the main menu.
glitches.extra_content: Associated room: #Infinite Core on the Discord.

variations.text: Water (ICW) - Using a water core recharges the æther, allowing to spam the powers.
Poison (ICP) - Nothing huge found yet out of chaining the poison jumps.
Steam (ICS) - Very useful because it resets the void timer, allowing to fly and fall forever. Perfect with the Respawn Infinite Dash.
Glitch (ICG) - The warp resets the void timer too, allowing to fly and fall as well.

glitches.note: ⚠️ WORK IN PROGRESS: a consistent setup is still being searched for — help is welcome!

glitches.title: Point Zero ❌
glitches.how_to: This place is located at certain coordinates far from the levels, and can be reached by quickly coming back to the menu (keep mashing to continue quickly). The first frame when One spawns in the game, she will be standing there on a small platform, before being replaced at the last soft checkpoint.
glitches.extra_content: If you quickly go back to the menu twice in a row, you can actually place your soft checkpoint on the Point Zero and stay there. From that, many things might be possible!
glitches.note: ❌ Not possible anymore, until further proof.

glitches.title: Invincibility Glitch ❌
glitches.search_desc: Insensible to any type of death blow
glitches.card_style: border: 2px solid #ff6b9d; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.05), rgba(0, 245, 255, 0.03));
glitches.how_to: Doing the setup of the Void Cancel, if you go back to the menu after losing all your HP, it's possible to remain insensible to any type of death blow (you can receive damages, but never die).
glitches.note: ❌ Not possible anymore, until further proof.
